sentences: That vulture's eye made my blood turn cold
I rushed at him, and he gave one scream
They went on talking and smiling as before
I raised my voice, but the beating grew louder too
Finally, he groaned softly in fear, not pain

items.source_sentence: That vulture's eye made my blood turn cold
items.source_sentence_ja: あのハゲタカの目を見て、私は血の気が引いた。

items.source_sentence: I rushed at him, and he gave one scream
items.source_sentence_ja: 私は彼に飛びかかり、彼は一声叫んだ。

items.source_sentence: They went on talking and smiling as before
items.source_sentence_ja: 彼らは以前と同じように、話したり笑ったりし続けた。

items.source_sentence: I raised my voice, but the beating grew louder too
items.source_sentence_ja: 私は声を張り上げたが、鼓動もまたいっそう大きくなった。

items.source_sentence: Finally, he groaned softly in fear, not pain
items.source_sentence_ja: ついに彼は、痛みからではなく恐怖から、かすかにうめいた。
